description: Shared state between the Collections agent, its widget and the app: one DashboardSpec (JSON) per row. Last write wins on contoso_version.

columns.description: Set when the dashboard is scoped to one customer.

relationships.note: VERIFY: lookups from a native table to a BC virtual table. Optional; contoso_customerno is enough for the demo. Create it in the maker portal if supported in your environment.

notes: The row id is the spec id (GUID) so the MCP server and the PCF upsert the same row.
Security: Collections agent users need Create/Read/Write at User level; the MCP server writes as the user (OBO).
